title.en: Baidu publishes ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base pretraining weights
title.zhHans: 百度发布文心 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 预训练权重

searchSummary.en: Baidu’s public repository contains pretrained weights, with a November 5 license date and territorial and commercial-use restrictions.
searchSummary.zhHans: 百度公开仓库含预训练权重，许可文件注明 11 月 5 日并附有地域与商业使用限制。

summary.en: Baidu’s ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base model card offers pretrained base-model weights and describes 280 billion total parameters and 14 billion active per token. Its model license is dated November 5, the same day a Chinese technology report described the release; the repository itself was created October 21, so its first public-download time is not established. The custom license excludes the EU, UK and South Korea from its territory and requires written authorization above US$50 million in related rolling annual revenue. This is not an unrestricted Apache or MIT release, and Baidu’s benchmark comparisons were not independently reproduced here.
summary.zhHans: 百度的 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 模型卡提供预训练基座权重，列出总参数 2800 亿、每 token 激活 140 亿。其专用许可注明 11 月 5 日，中文科技报道也在同日记录发布；仓库创建于 10 月 21 日，不能据此推定首次公开下载时间。许可适用地域不包括欧盟、英国和韩国；相关产品或服务过去连续 12 个月收入超过 5000 万美元时，商业使用须取得书面授权。这不是不受限制的 Apache 或 MIT 发布，本轮也未独立复现百度的跑分比较。

narrative.en: November 5 is the license and report disclosure date rather than a proven first download. The model is a base checkpoint before mid- or post-training, not a chat model with demonstrated production uptake. Revenue thresholds apply to related products or services, not the company’s market valuation.
narrative.zhHans: 11 月 5 日是许可和报道的日期，不能证明首次下载发生在当天。这是中训练或后训练之前的基座检查点，不是已证实生产采用的聊天模型。收入门槛针对相关产品或服务，而非公司估值。

text.en: The publicly listed ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base repository includes weight files; its November 5 license and contemporaneous report date the disclosed release, not the first download.
text.zhHans: 公开的 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 仓库包含权重文件；11 月 5 日许可及同期报道对应发布披露，并非首次下载时间。

text.en: The proprietary license excludes the EU, UK and South Korea from its territory and conditions above-threshold commercial use on separate written authorization.
text.zhHans: 专用许可的适用地域不含欧盟、英国和韩国；超出指定收入门槛的商业使用须另行取得书面授权。
